sketch.name: LiftingScheduleTracker
sketch.description: A planned-versus-actual tracker: each row shows a planned amount as a track, the actual as its fill and a pace marker for how far along the period is, with a computed Ahead / On pace / Behind / Over status; sortable, with a total line.
sketch.html: Name Pace % Status

props.name: plannedLabel
props.description: Caption of the planned amount (Contracted, Scheduled, Nominated).

props.name: actualLabel
props.description: Caption of the actual amount (Lifted, Received, Burned).

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit of the amounts (gal, tons, MMBtu, bu).

props.name: paceRatio
props.description: How far along the period is, 0 to 1: the expected share of the planned amount by now.

props.name: tolerance
props.description: Share of the planned amount a row may be off pace before it is Ahead or Behind.

props.name: sortBy
props.description: The column the rows are sorted by.

props.name: rows
props.description: The tracked rows: { label, sublabel, planned, actual }.

sketch.notes: Simple control, one class (LiftingScheduleTracker) plus its row data as plain records (Label, Sublabel, Planned, Actual: any list of objects or dictionaries, like the other GridKrafter components), event arguments for rowSelected and sortChanged, a sort-by enum, the client class and the theme mixin. Status: Over when actual > planned; Behind when actual < paceRatio*planned - tolerance*planned; Ahead when actual > paceRatio*planned + tolerance*planned; else On pace. Pace marker is aligned across rows (one shared scale up to the largest ratio, at least 100%). Extra props beyond the brief: tolerance, sortBy, sortDescending; extra event sortChanged. Fits a GridBoard card from about 300x200 to 1000x600: below ~420px wide the amounts and chip columns drop out.
